targets.failed_criterion_detail: Both load-bearing discrimination criteria failed: C1_dense_merged_degrades_vs_separated and C2_sparse_merged_degrades_vs_separated. Every readiness / absolute / non-degeneracy gate PASSED, including the two new dv_headroom gates: control_arm_coverage_complete 8/8; harm_head_action_sensitivity_present worst control cell 0.1138 vs floor 0.05 (2.3x); p1_harm_events_observed_per_condition min 1616 vs floor 10 (161.6x); H1 dv_headroom_margin_room_below_control floor_headroom 0.22857 vs MARGIN 0.15 (1.52x); H2 dv_headroom_control_signal_floor_reachable max_abs 0.71546 vs 0.40 required (1.79x). criteria_non_degenerate true for BOTH conditions, so the pre-registered combination rule applied in full and returned merged_channel_hypothesis_not_supported = weakens. This is the INVERSE of the substrate-ceiling fingerprint (where absolute gates pass and discrimination fails because the DV has no room): here headroom was measured over the CONTROL arm before any MERGED cell trained, and the discrimination still failed. Step 7c red-team F4 bounds what that headroom certifies, and the bound is recorded rather than argued away: H1 declares dv_bounds [0.0, 1.0] and computes floor_headroom = min(control) - 0.0, but calibration_gap is a difference of mean logit differences and is unbounded BELOW (the driver says so itself at lines 203-205, and negative components appear in this run's own cells). So H1 certifies that the CONTROL arm's signal sits at least MARGIN above zero -- NOT that the MERGED arm had room to degrade, which on an unbounded-below DV is vacuous. The question a null actually needs answered is POWER, not headroom, and the power arithmetic is in the scale row.

four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: unclear -- for the NECESSITY half of ARC-021 and for MECH-069's collapse-degrades-harm-calibration consequence, at this scale. ARC-021's own what_would_answer names this exact test ('merging E1/E2/E3 into a shared trunk/single optimizer ... should measurably DEGRADE calibration_gap') and its FALSIFYING signature ('statistically indistinguishable from -- or better than -- the separated-channel baseline ... across both dense- and sparse-hazard conditions'). The run produced that signature on ONE of the two DVs the signature names: DENSE mean paired diff -0.0064 (4 percent of MARGIN, 2 of 4 seeds negative), SPARSE +0.1120 in the OPPOSITE direction (1 of 4 seeds negative). WHY `unclear` AND NOT `weakened` (Step 7c red-team F1/F2, ratified at the Step 8 gate 2026-09-05): (i) the correct t(3) 95 percent intervals on the paired means -- [-0.204, +0.191] DENSE and [-0.158, +0.382] SPARSE -- do NOT exclude the pre-registered -0.15 in either condition, and joint power at -0.15 is about 12 percent, so a FAIL is the modal outcome even when the claim is exactly right; (ii) the falsifier names calibration_gap AND attribution accuracy, and only calibration_gap was read; (iii) 'statistically indistinguishable' is not what a threshold-plus-sign-consistency criterion tests, and at this power 'indistinguishable' means 'underpowered'; (iv) the merge was performed on a driver-local three-head surrogate over a frozen z_world, not the E1/E2/E3 predictor stack the claim's own precondition names by file. This remains the most on-target evidence ARC-021 has ever received and the first time the ablation it names has run with a working readout -- INFORMATIVE, and emphatically not non_contributory, but not a clean falsification either. NOT falsification: see also the implementation row.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- and, unusually, the biology is itself CONTESTED in exactly the direction this null points. Parallel segregated cortico-striatal loops (Alexander/DeLong; Haber 2003 corticostriatal spirals; O'Reilly & Frank 2006; Hazy 2007) are a strong existence proof for three anatomically distinct loops. The 2026-09-04 campaign-C4 pull (targeted_review_connectome_mech_069, 5 entries) splits on whether the error signals are separately COMPUTED or merely separately GATED: Engel 2024 (heterogeneous striatal dopamine across NAc-core/DMS/DLS, supports, 0.78), Groessl 2018 (PAG-to-dopamine fear gate, a distinct harm channel, supports, 0.72), Wolpert 1998 (cerebellar forward internal models, supports, 0.66), Engelhard 2019 (specialized sensory/motor/cognitive coding in VTA DA neurons, mixed, 0.68) -- against Schultz 1998 (weakens, 0.60), the explicit counterweight, whose position is that dopamine neurons 'fail to discriminate between different rewards' and emit a global reinforcement signal that is differentiated DOWNSTREAM. This run's null is precisely what Schultz's position predicts: one shared teaching channel, differentiated at the readout, suffices. So the FAIL does NOT contradict the biological existence proof for parallel loops; it bears on whether separate COMPUTATION at the source is required, which is the open question in the biology too.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: present in the SURROGATE's sense, not in the substrate the precondition sentence names (Step 7c red-team F2c / H4). ARC-021's stated non-degeneracy precondition reads 'requires the three error channels to be genuinely separately optimized IN THE SUBSTRATE UNDER TEST' and then names E1 (E1DeepPredictor), E2 and E3 (E3TrajectorySelector) by module path. The SEPARATED arm satisfies the TOPOLOGICAL reading of that sentence -- three disjoint parameter sets, three independent Adam instances, three independent backward passes, verified in the driver source (SeparatedChannels.train_step), depth-, width- and clip-matched to MERGED (design red-team F5), so parameter SHARING and loss SUMMATION are the only remaining differences -- but the modules separately optimized are experiment-local heads, not the named substrate. Reading the precondition as satisfied here is a substitution of substrate, and it is recorded as one rather than waved through. `depends_on` ARC-004 / MECH-033 / ARC-018 are not implicated.
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- and this is the load-bearing qualifier on the whole adjudication. The ablation is a faithful TOPOLOGY analogue but is instantiated in an experiment-local three-head surrogate (SensoryHead / ForwardHead / action-conditioned HarmHead over a 32-dim z_world), not in the ree_core E1DeepPredictor / E2WorldForward / E2HarmSForward / E3TrajectorySelector modules ARC-021's what_would_answer names by file. Three specific consequences: (1) there is no E3 SELECTION role at all -- behaviour is a uniform-random policy and the harm channel is a supervised BCE classifier, so 'harm/goal error' is instantiated as label prediction rather than as a valuation channel driving commitment; (2) the encoder is FROZEN during P1 (heads train on .detach()ed z_world), so the merge can contaminate only a downstream 2-layer trunk and cannot corrupt the LATENT itself, which is where cross-stream contamination would bite hardest biologically; (3) MERGED's three losses are summed with equal weight, an arbitrary commensuration the claim does not specify. The manipulation is real and the arms are clean; what is partial is the TRANSLATION from ARC-021's E1/E2/E3 sentence to this surrogate.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate -- CausalGridWorldV2 12x12 / 3x3 local view at BOTH hazard densities (DENSE 15, SPARSE 4), which is exactly the two-condition design ARC-021's falsifying signature requires. Harm events are abundant in both (1616 DENSE, 1878 SPARSE) and the near-hazard/safe probe populations are well populated and geometrically distinct in both (DENSE 683-698 near-hazard vs 49-84 safe; SPARSE 203-219 near-hazard vs 583-638 safe). The environment contains the pressure the mechanism is supposed to handle.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: adequate -- the strongest measurement posture in this family to date, and the reason the direction is allowed to stand. The readout was rebuilt (action-conditioned PRE-SIGMOID harm logit, trained on the distribution it is read on) after the predecessor's sigmoid-compression defect; the control arm rose from max |calibration_gap| 0.00152 (993) to 0.71546 here, a ~470x improvement, positive in 8 of 8 SEPARATED cells. SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR was RAISED 0.02 -> 0.20 and still cleared in both conditions (0.4544 / 0.3986). The bars were sized against a MEASURED paired null (24 cells, 3 head-init draws, mean +0.0216, sd 0.1659, sign not consistent across draw pairs). Residual measurement debt, stated by the driver itself (F9), not papered over, and CORRECTED here by the Step 7c red-team (F1): MARGIN 0.15 with n=4 absorbs any sub-margin degradation. The interval on a paired mean of n=4 must use the t(3) multiplier 3.182, not 1.96 -- the correct 95 percent intervals are [-0.204, +0.191] in DENSE (mean -0.0064, sd 0.1240) and [-0.158, +0.382] in SPARSE (mean +0.1120, sd 0.1696). The run therefore excludes a merged-degradation of roughly 0.20 or larger in DENSE and roughly 0.16 or larger in SPARSE, and does NOT exclude the pre-registered -0.15 in EITHER condition. The draft's earlier z-intervals ([-0.128, +0.115] DENSE / [-0.054, +0.278] SPARSE) and the '0.13+ / 0.05+ excluded' clause were wrong and are WITHDRAWN. Measurement stays `adequate` -- the instrument works and the control arm carries real signal -- but adequate INSTRUMENTATION is not adequate POWER, and the two were conflated in the draft.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: isolated -- deliberately. No ree_core.agent / REEAgent, no E1/E2/E3 predictor module, no latent stack, no sleep loop. This is the same property recorded in the implementation row and is why the result cannot reach the whole-agent form of ARC-021.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate for the effect sizes the design was powered for, marginal at the pre-registered bar. 4 seeds x 2 conditions x 2 arms, 80 P0 + 80 P1 episodes x 120 steps, 15 probe resets. Against the measured per-cell null sd 0.1659 the full criterion (mean <= -MARGIN AND all 4 seeds <= 0) has roughly 35 percent power PER CONDITION at a true effect of exactly -0.15 (Step 7c red-team F1, Monte Carlo, 200k draws; the draft's 'roughly 40 percent' was both imprecise and, more importantly, per-condition rather than whole-run). The pre-registered PASS requires BOTH conditions, so JOINT power at -0.15 is about 12 percent (0.353 squared). At -0.30 it is about 85 percent per condition and about 73 percent jointly. Consequence, stated plainly: this design returns a FAIL roughly 88 percent of the time when ARC-021 is exactly right at the effect size the run itself pre-registered. The observed point estimates ARE null-to-reversed (DENSE -0.0064, SPARSE +0.1120) and that is worth recording -- but at this power it CANNOT be used as a premise that the result is more than an unmet bar. The draft's 'null-to-reversed ESTIMATE, not merely an unmet bar' licence for `weakens` is WITHDRAWN.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: parallel segregated cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamic loops (Alexander/DeLong) with channel-specific dopaminergic teaching signals; cerebellar forward internal models as the motor-sensory channel; PAG-to-dopamine nociceptive gating as the harm channel
dependencies: channel-specific teaching signals at the source (contested: Engel 2024 / Engelhard 2019 for, Schultz 1998 against)
a selection/commitment stage that consumes the harm channel with its own authority (absent from this design)
representation learning downstream of, not upstream of, the channel split (the frozen-encoder limitation)
biological_reference.divergence: none identified in the mechanism's translation direction. The relevant divergence is INTERNAL to the biology: whether the three error signals are separately computed or separately gated is an open question in the dopamine literature itself, and ARC-021 asserts the stronger (separately computed / separate learning channels) reading. This run's null is compatible with the weaker gating reading, which is Schultz 1998's position and is recorded in the C4 pull as a deliberate counterweight.
biological_reference.lit_status: present -- targeted_review_connectome_arc_021 (3 entries, 2026-03-29: Haber 2003, Hazy 2007, O'Reilly 2006), targeted_review_connectome_mech_069 (5 entries, 2026-09-04, campaign C4: Engel 2024, Engelhard 2019, Groessl 2018, Wolpert 1998, Schultz 1998), targeted_review_reafference_streams (Haak & Beckmann 2018). No lit-pull commission is owed.

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Both stay `standard` (both already store it). This is a genuine evidence result, not a ceiling: the control arm carried real signal in 8 of 8 cells (max |calibration_gap| 0.71546, a ~470x lift over the predecessor) and the run reached a verdict on a working instrument, so nothing here asserts that the claims' answers are gated on substrate work. Note (Step 7c red-team F4) that the H1/H2 headroom gates certify the CONTROL arm's signal rather than the MERGED arm's room to degrade, so the 'not a ceiling' conclusion rests on the control-arm signal and the repaired readout, NOT on a headroom argument. Deliberately NOT substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional: those sit in _EPI_SUPPRESS_PROPOSAL and _UNTESTABLE_EPISTEMIC and would strip v3 experiment lanes from two claims that have just demonstrated they can receive experimental evidence. The residual scope limitation (surrogate heads rather than the E1/E2/E3 stack) is a NEW, separately-routed question, not a suppression.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-993a (2026-09-04, supersedes V3-EXQ-993) is the merged-channel ablation ARC-021's what_would_answer has named as 'the missing test' since 2026-03. It is the FIRST run in this family with a working readout: the action-conditioned PRE-SIGMOID harm logit, trained on the distribution it is read on, lifted the SEPARATED control arm's max |calibration_gap| from 0.00152 (993, 13.1x below its own 0.02 floor) to 0.71546, positive in 8 of 8 control cells, with SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR raised 0.02 -> 0.20 and still cleared in both conditions (DENSE 0.4544, SPARSE 0.3986). Every readiness gate passed, including the two dv_headroom gates minted by the 2026-09-03 cluster autopsy's substrate entry dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class (H1 floor_headroom 0.22857 vs MARGIN 0.15 = 1.52x; H2 max_abs 0.71546 vs 0.40 = 1.79x), both evaluated over the control arm BEFORE any MERGED cell trained. RESULT: merging the three channels into one shared trunk under one optimizer and one summed loss did NOT degrade harm calibration AT THE PRE-REGISTERED BAR. DENSE mean paired diff -0.0064 (merged 0.44801 vs separated 0.45438; per-seed -0.0147 / -0.1784 / +0.0736 / +0.0941, 2 of 4 negative); SPARSE +0.1120 in the OPPOSITE direction (merged 0.51061 vs separated 0.39862; per-seed +0.3521 / -0.0153 / +0.1105 / +0.0006, 1 of 4 negative). Both criteria required mean <= -0.15 AND all 4 seeds <= 0; both failed on both clauses, so the driver's pre-registered combination rule emitted `weakens`. GOVERNANCE RECORDS `mixed`, NOT `weakens`, AND THIS IS A DELIBERATE DEPARTURE FROM THE PRE-REGISTERED RULE (user gate, 2026-09-05, after a cross-model Step 7c red-team returned CONTESTED). Four grounds, in order of weight. (1) EFFECT SIZE, CORRECTED. The bound originally drafted into this note ([-0.128, +0.115] DENSE / [-0.054, +0.278] SPARSE) was computed with a z-multiplier on n=4 paired diffs and is WITHDRAWN. The correct t(3) 95 percent intervals are [-0.204, +0.191] (DENSE, mean -0.0064, sd 0.1240) and [-0.158, +0.382] (SPARSE, mean +0.1120, sd 0.1696), which do NOT exclude the pre-registered -0.15 in EITHER condition. What the run excludes is a merged degradation of roughly 0.20+ (DENSE) / 0.16+ (SPARSE), and nothing smaller. Power at a true -0.15 is about 35 percent per condition and about 12 percent JOINTLY (the PASS requires both), i.e. this design returns FAIL roughly 88 percent of the time when ARC-021 is exactly right at its own pre-registered effect; at -0.30, power is about 85 percent per condition and about 73 percent jointly. (2) ONE FALSIFIER DV OF TWO. ARC-021's falsifying signature names calibration_gap AND attribution accuracy; this driver reads calibration_gap only, so the signature was met on half of what it specifies. (3) PRECONDITION SUBSTRATE. The non-degeneracy precondition requires the three channels to be separately optimized IN THE SUBSTRATE UNDER TEST and names E1DeepPredictor / E2*Forward / E3TrajectorySelector by file; the SEPARATED arm satisfies it only in the SURROGATE's sense (experiment-local sensory-reconstruction / forward-prediction / action-conditioned harm heads over a frozen 32-dim z_world), with no E3 selection role and a uniform-random policy, so the merge could contaminate only a downstream 2-layer trunk and never the latent itself. (4) HEADROOM IS NOT POWER. H1's `dv_bounds: [0.0, 1.0]` declaration is false for a DV that is a difference of mean logit differences and is unbounded below, so the headroom gates certify the CONTROL arm's signal rather than the MERGED arm's room to degrade; 'the DV had measured room to move' is withdrawn as a licence for a direction. WHAT `mixed` MEANS HERE, precisely: the run is INFORMATIVE and is emphatically NOT non_contributory -- it is the first working-readout instance of the claim's own named ablation, its control arm carries real signal in 8 of 8 cells, and it does rule out a LARGE merged degradation in a faithful topology analogue. It does not exclude the effect ARC-021 predicts, and it did not test the substrate the claim names. IT DOES NOT BEAR ON: the descriptive claim that REE currently instantiates three separately-optimized channels (true, and verified in this run's control arm); MECH-069's scale / covariance / temporal incommensurability content (v3_exq_005's question, untouched here); or the biological existence proof for parallel cortico-striatal loops. TWO FURTHER BOUNDS, recorded rather than argued away: SPARSE's apparent ADVANTAGE for merging is carried by one seed -- dropping seed 101 (+0.3521) leaves mean +0.0319, so the defensible statement is 'indistinguishable at this power, possibly better', not 'merging helps'; and BIOLOGY -- the null direction is compatible with error signals being separately GATED rather than separately COMPUTED (Schultz 1998, a deliberate counterweight in the 2026-09-04 C4 pull), against which Engel 2024 / Engelhard 2019 / Groessl 2018 / Wolpert 1998 argue for genuine channel specificity, so the biology is contested in exactly the direction this run points. MANIFEST OVERRIDE OWED: the flat manifest and the run-pack manifest BOTH carry evidence_direction `weakens` and evidence_direction_per_claim weakens/weakens, and the indexer has already scored that, so governance must write `mixed` onto BOTH copies together with an evidence_direction_note citing this artifact -- see `recommended_manifest_write`. A claims.yaml note alone would leave the scored direction disagreeing with the adjudication. STATUS: ARC-021 stays `provisional` and MECH-069 stays `stable` -- one scoped, underpowered surrogate run does not move either, and the driver itself pre-registered that this run 'tests the collapse-degrades-E3 consequence, not MECH-069's scale/temporal content, so it cannot on its own demote a stable claim'. PENDING RETEST: the retest owed by the 2026-09-03 cluster autopsy (`pending_retest_after_substrate: true`, condition 'once the readout is fixed') HAS NOW RUN and cleared its preconditions, so the flag should be cleared on BOTH claims -- see GFLAG-0137, raised precisely because the IGW routine keeps re-spawning 'Retest after substrate: ARC-021' against a discharged condition. The remaining substrate-fidelity question (does this null survive on the real E1/E2/E3 stack, with a live selection role and an unfrozen encoder) is routed as a NEW experiment, not as an unresolved retest flag.

A cross-model Step 7c red-team on the ADJUDICATION returned CONTESTED and the Step 8 human gate ratified `mixed` instead. Two further limits reinforce it: only one of ARC-021's two falsifier DVs (calibration_gap, not attribution accuracy) was read, and the merge was performed on driver-local surrogate heads over a frozen z_world rather than the E1/E2/E3 stack the claim's precondition names by file. The run remains informative -- it rules out a large merged degradation (roughly 0.20+ DENSE / 0.16+ SPARSE) in a faithful topology analogue on a working readout -- but it is not a clean falsification, so `mixed` rather than `weakens`. Full reasoning: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-993a_2026-09-05.md sections 4, 5 and 13.

EXT-003.relationship: dropped from claim_ids relative to V3-EXQ-993; flagged by the driver for governance ratification; NOT a target of this autopsy and NOT adjudicated here
EXT-003.autopsy_view: ENDORSE THE DROP. EXT-003 asserts an EXPLOITATION failure mode -- 'scalar reward conflates incommensurable error signals' so an agent satisfies the reward by optimising one channel at the expense of the others. V3-EXQ-993a has no reward, no policy optimisation and no agent maximising anything: behaviour is a uniform-random policy and all three channels are supervised prediction targets, so nothing in the design can hack anything in either direction. Tagging it would let a claim-scoring consumer read `reward hacking tested` off a design with no reward, which is exactly the claim_ids-accuracy failure mode REE_assembly/CLAUDE.md rule 3 warns about ('err toward fewer tags'). The drop costs EXT-003 nothing: V3-EXQ-993 tagged it and was adjudicated non_contributory, so no evidence entry is lost.
EXT-003.counter_argument_considered_and_rejected: The MERGED arm does instantiate the MECHANISM half of EXT-003's rider (one scalar objective summed over three error terms), so a partial/mixed tag could be argued. Rejected: EXT-003's polarity asserts the exploit, and a design in which nothing can exploit anything cannot bear on it in either direction. Under-tagging here PROTECTS the 2026-09-03 user ruling that EXT-003 waits on EXPERIMENTAL evidence -- the right response is a probe that actually instantiates a reward and an optimisation loop, not a tag on a supervised prediction study.
EXT-003.bears_on_note_for_governance: EXT-003's `ree_mechanism` field cites MECH-069 and ARC-021 as the reason REE resists reward hacking ('REE maintains three distinct BG-like loops with separate learning channels that cannot be mutually satisfied by a single exploit'). That rider INHERITS whatever ARC-021/MECH-069 lose here, without any evidence tag on EXT-003 itself. Governance should note the inheritance when it next reviews EXT-003's status -- this is the sibling-claim bears-on the re-adjudication rule asks for, recorded even though EXT-003 is out of scope.

The item's stated target was 'a control-arm signal at or above the registered 0.02 floor, established BEFORE the ablation arm is run'. 993a establishes it through this entry's own machinery: the dv_headroom precondition kind evaluated the SEPARATED cells before any MERGED cell trained and measured floor_headroom 0.22857 (H1, 1.52x over MARGIN 0.15) and max_abs 0.71546 (H2, 1.79x over the 0.40 required), against a floor RAISED to 0.20. Control-arm max |calibration_gap| went 0.00152 -> 0.71546, positive in 8 of 8 cells. The other open item on this entry (v3_exq_999_mech161_...) is untouched and stays open. Caveat carried from Step 7c red-team F4 and F6: the item's target IS met and closing it is justified, but the accompanying validation is PASS-path only (first of six queued validations, refusal path never fired) and rides on a `dv_bounds [0.0, 1.0]` declaration that is false for this DV -- see amend_intent.

failure_location.net_classification: MIXED, MECHANISM-partial -- not chargeable to REE alone, and specifically not REE FAILED. Measurement and environment each read independently adequate here, which is rare in this corpus and is why the run is INFORMATIVE rather than non_contributory: the readout was rebuilt and verified before the arms were compared, the control arm carried real signal in 8 of 8 cells (~470x over the predecessor), and both hazard densities were present. That is NOT, however, a licence for `weakens`, and the draft's two licensing premises are withdrawn at the Step 8 gate: (i) 'the DV had measured room to move' -- Step 7c red-team F4 shows H1's `dv_bounds [0.0, 1.0]` declaration is false for an unbounded-below DV, so the headroom gates certify the CONTROL arm's signal, not the merged arm's room to degrade; (ii) the 'null-to-reversed point estimate' -- the corrected t(3) 95 percent intervals ([-0.204, +0.191] DENSE, [-0.158, +0.382] SPARSE) do NOT exclude the predicted -0.15 in either condition, and joint power there is about 12 percent. Adequate INSTRUMENTATION is not adequate POWER. Claim alignment therefore reads `unclear` and the recorded direction is `mixed`. What is only PARTIAL is the mechanism's translation: the ablation merged three experiment-local surrogate heads over a frozen latent, with no E3 selection role, rather than the ree_core E1/E2/E3 predictor stack ARC-021 names by file -- and the falsifier's second DV (attribution accuracy) was never read. So the correct organism-level statement is NOT 'REE's three-loop separation is unnecessary' but 'a faithful topology analogue of the separation, tested where it was supposed to bite at a power that could only have caught a large effect, did not bite -- and the untested residue is the real stack AND the second DV, not the instrument.'

targets.node_classification_note: The frame is well posed -- we know exactly what to merge, exactly what to measure, and the readout now works. What is missing is a FACT: does the null survive when the merge is performed on the real E1/E2/E3 stack, with a live selection role and an unfrozen encoder? That is a spike, not a build (so not `complicated (buildable)`), and it is not `mystery (known data)` -- we do not already have the data and reframing alone will not settle it. It is not `aleatoric (irreducible)`: the residual is not noise, it is a named untested configuration.
learning_extracted: A prescribed readout repair worked, at scale, and the size is worth recording: reading the harm signal as an ACTION-CONDITIONED PRE-SIGMOID logit trained on the distribution it is read on, rather than a post-transition sigmoid, moved the control arm's max |calibration_gap| from 0.00152 to 0.71546 (~470x) and made 8 of 8 control cells positive. The 2026-09-03 cluster autopsy's localisation was correct.

The deeper defect the redesign found is a TRAINING-TARGET defect, not a readout one, and it generalises: causal_grid_world.py:2745 writes grid[new_x,new_y]='agent' on every committed move, so a head trained h(z_t1) -> harm_label is taught that post-harm states look safe (measured harm_discrim_logit 0.042 and -0.029 in DENSE). Any future driver labelling a transition outcome on the POST-transition observation in this environment inherits the same erasure.

The dv_headroom precondition class RAN as designed on its first production use -- it measured the control arm's room BEFORE the ablation arm trained (H1 1.52x, H2 1.79x) and let the run reach a verdict rather than self-routing a requeue. But Step 7c red-team F4 bounds what that validates: H1 declared `dv_bounds: [0.0, 1.0]` for a DV that is a difference of mean logit differences and is unbounded BELOW, and the class did not catch the false declaration. On an unbounded-below DV, `floor_headroom = min(control) - lower_bound` certifies the CONTROL arm's signal, not the ablation arm's room to degrade -- so the gate must never be cited as evidence that a null 'had somewhere to fall'. This is PASS-path evidence only: the first of six queued validations, with the refusal path still unexercised in production.

RAISING a non-degeneracy floor is the correct response to a repaired instrument, not lowering it: SEPARATED_SIGNAL_FLOOR went 0.02 -> 0.20 (10x) and was cleared in both conditions with room to spare. The predecessor autopsy's refusal to relax the floor is vindicated.

A precondition-cleared FAIL in the falsifying direction is not automatically a falsification, and TWO independent questions have to be answered before treating it as one. (i) Is the mechanism under test the claim's OWN mechanism or a surrogate for it? Here the topology was faithful but the modules merged were experiment-local heads over a frozen latent, not the E1/E2/E3 stack ARC-021 names -- and only one of the falsifier's two DVs was read. (ii) Could the design have DETECTED the predicted effect? Here it could not reliably: joint power at the pre-registered -0.15 is about 12 percent, so FAIL is the modal outcome even when the claim is exactly right. The draft called this run 'clean, well-powered' -- it was clean, it was not well-powered at its own pre-registered effect, and that adjective was doing load-bearing work in the direction argument until the red-team removed it.

Pre-registering a margin buys a false-positive guarantee and pays for it in a stated blind spot. The driver's F9 states it: MARGIN 0.15 with n=4 absorbs any sub-margin degradation. Recording the per-seed diffs in interpretation.condition_detail is what keeps that visible -- and it is what let this autopsy report that SPARSE's apparent merged ADVANTAGE is carried by one seed (+0.3521 on 101; mean falls to +0.0319 without it) rather than repeating the label.

A claim's what_would_answer can name a test that is only instantiable at two very different fidelities (surrogate heads vs the named modules). When it names modules BY FILE, an autopsy should check which one actually ran before treating the falsifying signature as met.

The Step 7b C1 check earned its keep here in a way the check itself cannot know: it named an existing never-scored driver (v3_spark_arc021_three_loop_scale.py) which turned out to implement the exact ablation the fanout's highest-value leg needs, on the real E1/E2/E3 stack. A C1 fire is worth reading as 'someone may already have built your next experiment', not only as 'you may be duplicating this one'.

An n=4 paired mean needs the t(3) multiplier 3.182, not 1.96 -- and the difference is not cosmetic when the number lands in a STORABLE field. The draft's z-intervals understated each half-width by about 38 percent and converted an interval that INCLUDES the pre-registered -0.15 into one that appeared to exclude it, inside an evidence_quality_note governance copies verbatim into claims.yaml. Two standing lessons: recompute effect-size bounds with the small-sample multiplier before writing them into a storable field, and always state the POWER at the pre-registered effect alongside the interval -- that is what stops 'not detected' being read as 'excluded'.

A positional read of a preconditions list is fragile against later insertions, and the failure is silent. The 993a driver computes `worst_harm_sensitivity = preconditions[0]['measured']` (line 1336); the DESIGN red-team's F6 later inserted `control_arm_coverage_complete` at the head of that list, so `metrics.worst_harm_action_sensitivity` records 8.0 -- the coverage COUNT -- instead of the true 0.11382 at preconditions[1]. `validate_recording.py` reports OK because the SCHEMA is intact; a schema check cannot see a wrong VALUE in a right FIELD. Index preconditions by `name`, never by position.

A cross-model Step 7c red-team changed this adjudication's recorded direction, its stored effect-size bound, its claim_alignment cell and its fan-out repair list -- none of which the authoring pass had flagged as uncertain. The two defects that mattered most (a z-interval on n=4, and a positional list read) were both ARITHMETIC/MECHANICAL rather than interpretive, which is exactly the class a second reader catches cheaply and an author re-reading their own prose does not.

live_hypotheses: H1: channel separation genuinely is NOT required for harm calibration -- ARC-021's necessity half is false and this null is the truth.

H2: the surrogate is too shallow to express the contamination -- the frozen encoder confines the merge to a downstream trunk, there is no E3 selection role, and the equal-weight loss sum is an arbitrary commensuration; the null is a translation artefact.
H3: the degradation is real but SUB-MARGIN (< 0.15) and this design cannot resolve it -- the driver's own F9.

suggested_probes.sketch: Extend the merge UPSTREAM: run the same two arms with the encoder UNFROZEN and jointly optimised in P1, so a collapsed objective can corrupt the latent itself rather than only a downstream trunk. Null: DENSE and SPARSE mean paired diffs both still > -0.15 with no sign consistency. A degradation appearing only here localises the effect to representation learning, which is where the biology puts it.

Perform the ablation on the ACTUAL ree_core stack -- E1/E2/E3 merged under ONE optimizer over agent.parameters() with a combined loss -- inside a live REEAgent loop with E3 actually selecting, measuring the action-conditioned calibration_gap plus a selection-level harm-avoidance readout (harm_rate). Null: no degradation beyond the pre-registered margin in either condition. This is the test ARC-021's what_would_answer literally names and is the one thing 993a did not do. START FROM THE EXISTING DRIVER, DO NOT AUTHOR A FOURTH: `ree-v3/experiments/v3_spark_arc021_three_loop_scale.py` already implements exactly this shape (imports REEAgent, SEPARATE = three independent optimizers vs MERGED = one optimizer over agent.parameters() with combined loss E1+E2+E3, at REEConfig.large world_dim=128, scoring e3_discrim AND harm_rate) and has NEVER produced a manifest -- surfaced by this autopsy's Step 7b C1 fire and verified at source. SIX repairs are MANDATORY before it runs -- (a) and (b) from the Step 7b read, (c) to (f) added by the Step 7c red-team (F3), which read the file at source. (a) Its C1 bar `e3_discrim_separate > e3_discrim_merged + 0.02` is UNMEASURED, the same defect class 993 died of, so it must be re-derived from a measured control arm. (b) It carries NO dv_headroom precondition, so H1/H2 gates of the dv-dynamic-range-precondition-class kind must be added over its control arm before the MERGED arm trains -- and `dv_bounds` must be declared HONESTLY for whichever DV is chosen (an unbounded-below DV must not be declared [0.0, 1.0]; that false declaration is exactly this autopsy's red-team F4). (c) PAIR THE ARMS ON SEED. The spark runs `_run_condition('SEPARATE', args.seed, ...)` then `_run_condition('MERGED', args.seed + 1, ...)` (lines 318-320), so the two arms differ in env seed AND agent init -- the same unpaired-arm defect class the 993 design red-team fixed by pairing. (d) THE ENCODER-GRADIENT CONFOUND, which is the load-bearing one. `_train_step_separate` computes the harm loss on `latent.z_world.detach()` (line 108) while `_train_step_merged` uses the UNDETACHED `latent.z_world` with the comment 'allow contamination gradient' (lines 126-128). As written, the MERGED arm therefore differs from SEPARATE in TWO things at once: optimizer topology AND whether the harm gradient reaches the encoder. Those are precisely THIS fan-out's H1 (encoder-level merge) and H2 (real-stack merge) legs, so running the spark as-is would ALIAS them in a single arm -- the exact verdict-aliasing this fan-out note forbids. Fix: make the encoder gradient a SEPARATE FACTOR (a 2x2: optimizer topology x detach/undetach) or make it SYMMETRIC across arms, and state in the queue entry which of the two manipulations the leg isolates. (e) MULTI-SEED WITH A MEASURED PAIRED NULL. The spark is single-seed (default 42), with no sign-consistency rule and no measured null, so the bar in (a) would have nothing to be sized against and the run would have no defensible power statement. Given this autopsy's own power arithmetic (joint 12 percent at -0.15 on n=4), the successor must pre-register an effect it can actually detect rather than inheriting 993a's -0.15/n=4 design. (f) RUNNER/INDEXER-COMPATIBLE MANIFEST. Its output is an ad-hoc JSON -- no `claim_ids`, no `evidence_direction`, no recording-standard fields, no `--dry-run`, no `_experiment_lib` -- written to `REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/<type>/`. It must be rebuilt through `experiments/_lib` (`manifest_core.stamp_recording_core(...)`) or nothing it produces will be scored. RUNNABILITY IS UNVERIFIED, and the artifact says so rather than implying otherwise: every agent method the spark calls resolves by NAME against the current ree_core/agent.py (compute_prediction_loss, generate_trajectories, select_action, record_transition, update_residue, sense, reset; e1/e2/e3/latent_stack attributes; REEConfig.large; the CausalGridWorldV2 kwargs), but SIGNATURES were not checked and the file has never executed. A smoke run against current agent.py is the FIRST step of this leg, not an afterthought. Consider also adding the 993a calibration_gap readout alongside e3_discrim, since e3_discrim is a discrimination statistic rather than the SD-003 causal signature ARC-021's what_would_answer names -- that was the 993a driver's own stated reason for not treating the spark as a substitute, and it remains correct for 993a's question while being repairable for this one.

A sub-margin-sensitive re-pose: many more seeds (>= 16) and/or paired variance reduction (shared P0, common random numbers across arms), pre-registering a 0.05 effect rather than 0.15, with the criterion stated as a confidence interval on the paired mean rather than a threshold-plus-sign-consistency rule. Null: the 95 percent CI on the paired mean excludes -0.05 in both conditions.

draft_new_question.question: Is separate optimisation of the three BG-like learning channels (sensory prediction / motor-sensory forward / harm-goal) REQUIRED for harm calibration, or is one shared channel differentiated at the readout sufficient?
draft_new_question.note: Opened because V3-EXQ-993a is the first run in this family with a working readout and therefore the first that can adjudicate anything here. 993a's own reading was amended at the Step 8 gate from `weakens` to `mixed` after a cross-model Step 7c red-team, so leg 1 stays alive rather than resolving -- the run bounds the effect from above without excluding the one the leg predicts. legs.label: merging three surrogate channel heads into one trunk under one optimizer degrades harm calibration
legs.desc: In a driver-local three-head surrogate (sensory-reconstruction / forward-prediction / action-conditioned harm) over a frozen z_world, MERGED mean calibration_gap <= SEPARATED - 0.15 with all seeds sign-consistent, in BOTH hazard densities.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-993a returned DENSE mean paired diff -0.0064 (2 of 4 seeds negative) and SPARSE +0.1120 (1 of 4 seeds negative); both pre-registered criteria failed on both clauses, with H1/H2 dv_headroom cleared over the control arm beforehand and 8 of 8 control cells positive. The leg is NOT falsified and NOT eliminated: the correct t(3) 95 percent intervals on the paired means are [-0.204, +0.191] (DENSE) and [-0.158, +0.382] (SPARSE), so the run does NOT exclude this leg's own >= 0.15 degradation in either condition, and joint power at -0.15 is about 12 percent -- the bar is not met, so the state stays `alive`. What the run DOES establish is an upper bound: a merged degradation of roughly 0.20+ (DENSE) / 0.16+ (SPARSE) is excluded in this surrogate, on a working readout. Two further limits on how far the leg was even tested: only one of ARC-021's two falsifier DVs (calibration_gap, not attribution accuracy) was read, and the arm satisfies the claim's non-degeneracy precondition only in the surrogate's sense. WITHDRAWN at the Step 8 gate (2026-09-05): the draft's `falsified_at_this_scale` state, its `resolved_utc`, and its z-interval bound clause ('excludes roughly 0.13+ DENSE / 0.05+ SPARSE') -- all three were consequences of the same z-vs-t error (Step 7c red-team F1). PROVENANCE FLAG, unchanged: this leg was retro-registered and adjudicated by the SAME artifact, so it must not be counted as a live pre-registration when the Dimension 3/4 denominator is computed.
